item.title: API payments guide
item.description:
Description: This is content I wrote to document Guidewire’s Billing API. This chapter describes how producers (otherwise known as insurance agents or brokers) can make and manage payments to BillingCenter through the API.

Tools: Postman, Oxygen, Github

item.title: API reference doc improvements
item.description:
Explanation: At Guidewire, developers write and maintain the OpenAPI spec files, and I generate documentation from them using Docusaurus with a modified Redoc plugin.

Based on feedback we got from developers and doc site users, I made the following improvements to our API reference documentation. I wrote custom Javascript to process and render the specs, and CSS to make visual improvements.

See the API refs live at: https://docs.guidewire.com/cloud/bc/202511/apiref/

1. Sidebar overhaul

Problem: The sidebar placed all the endpoints in an OpenAPI spec together at the same level, and the sidebar only listed the paths, not the resources themselves. This made it hard to find information for specs with many endpoints and longer paths.

Tools: Oxygen (for authoring), Intellij (for testing)

Additional Context: This topic is part of the Cloud API Developer Guide, which describes in detail the configuration capabilities of Guidewire Cloud API. The target audience is configuration developers familiar with the Guidewire ecosystem.

item.title: Internal tooling documentation
item.description: Explanation: The Release Notes Generator is an internally-developed doc tool app that Guidewire writers use to pull release notes from Jira and format them in DITA. I took ownership of the Release Notes Generator after volunteering to assist our overworked documentation tool developer team. I have made a number of improvements to its functionality, and I revamped our internal documentation on it. The audience is both users of the release notes generator, and anyone who takes over development of the release note generator in the future.
